lines: Thirty-one years of rainfall on that shelf, and my mother's thirty before it.
Nobody asked us to keep them. We keep them because a wet March is a thing you can see coming.
A man from the Foundation copied the lot last summer. Very polite. Left the originals.
I can tell the level from the sound the engine makes. Everybody here can.
It is a bit higher today. Nobody has said anything, so it is fine.
